description: Top of GameData.bin: pointers to every sub-table and their counts, in the order GameData::Initialize (004E6954) hands them to Chapter/Person/Job/.../Arena::Initialize
Chapters (CID_): map model, route links, prep screen (Chapter::Initialize(const void*,int) gets header +0x0/+0x4)
Characters always loaded (archive 'resident', PID_): stats, growths, classes, skills (Person::Initialize gets header +0x8; Person::Get(unsigned short) = block+0x10+i*0x98)
Per-chapter characters (enemies, NPCs, bosses), one Person block per chapter file (Person::Load/LoadArchive); same record layout as Person
Classes (JID_) (Job::Initialize gets header +0xC; Job::Get(unsigned short) = block+0x8+i*0x80)
ID list JCID_: class category bits used by Job.category_flags (Job::IsFlyer tests JCID_ flying)
ID list SPID_: bit numbers of the Person/Job 64-bit flag words (looked up by PrivateSkill::Get(const char*) 001B7758)
Skills (SEID_) (EquipSkill::Initialize(const void*,int,int) gets header +0x10, +0x14 common count, +0x18 total count)
Armies / factions (BID_) (Belong::Initialize(const void*,int) gets header +0x24/+0x28)
Items and weapons (IID_) (Item::Initialize gets header +0x2C; Item::Get(unsigned short) = block+0x8+i*0x68)
ID list ISID_: bit numbers of Item.flags (Item::IsMagic tests ISID_ magic weapon)
ID list IUID_: item use effects (IUID_回復 heal, IUID_クラスチェンジ class change...); no Item field mapped to it yet
Per-chapter terrain file header: tile table, tile count, map model, grid (Terrain::Initialize(const char*))
Per-chapter terrain types (TID_): movement cost class, defence/avoid/heal bonuses
Per-chapter map grid: sizes and a 32x32 tile-index grid (indexes into that file's TerrainTile records)
Per-chapter unit groups (Player, Enemy, ReinforceNN...): name, first unit, unit count (map::Dispos::Header, map::Dispos::Calculate reads +0x4/+0x8)
Per-chapter unit placements: character, class, level, position, items, skills, AI (map::Dispos::Data, Unit::SetDispos)
Avatar boons and banes (Personality::Initialize(const void*,int) gets header +0x1C/+0x20; Personality::Get(int) = table+i*0x40): base, growth and maximum-stat modifiers
Weapon kinds (sword, lance, axe, dagger, bow, tome, staff, special, item) (ItemKind::Initialize gets header +0x30; ItemKind::Get(int) = table+i*0xC); no stored count
Weapon sub-kinds, the value of Item.weapon_kind (ItemSubKind::Initialize gets header +0x34; ItemSubKind::Get(int) = table+i*0x10): kind, Hoshido/Nohr origin, refine group
Forge bonus rows (ItemRefine::Initialize gets header +0x38; ItemRefine::Get(row,level) = table+(row*10+level)*4): might/hit/crit per forge level; Item.refine_index picks the row
Weapon rank thresholds S..E (WeaponLevel::Initialize gets header +0x3C; WeaponLevel::GetLevel(int) compares weapon exp with them)
Weapon rank bonuses per weapon kind (WeaponBonus::Initialize gets header +0x40; WeaponBonus::Get(ItemKind::Type) = table+kind*0xC; Unit::GetHit/GetAttack only call it for kinds < 8)
Weapon triangle (WeaponInteract::Initialize gets header +0x44): rank-scaled bonus plus the 8x8 advantage matrix of weapon kinds
Experience tables header (ExpTable::Initialize gets header +0x48): six pointers, one per sub-table; every sub-table has one row per difficulty (GameUserData+0x2D)
Experience for damaging and for defeating an enemy, by level difference (ExpTable::GetBattle(int) = [ExpTable+0x0]+row*0x48)
Minimum battle experience against high-level enemies (ExpTable::GetBattleThreshold(int) = [ExpTable+0x4]+row*0x18)
Staff experience change by the healer's level (ExpTable::GetRodDecline(int) = [ExpTable+0x8]+row*0x28)
Staff experience change for healers whose class also uses a non-staff weapon (ExpTable::GetRodHighDecline(int) = [ExpTable+0xC]+row*4)
Dance/sing experience by level (ExpTable::GetDance(int) = [ExpTable+0x10]+row*0x28)
Experience change by the level gap to the unit helped (staff, dance) (ExpTable::GetSupportDecline(int) = [ExpTable+0x14]+row*0x28)
Movement-cost table header (TerrainCost::Initialize gets header +0x4C): number of terrain columns per row
Movement cost per class move type (row = Job.move_cost_class) and terrain column (TerrainTile.move_cost_column) (TerrainCost::Get(int) / GetCostFromUnit)
Unnamed block at GameData header +0x50 (GameData::Initialize does not pass it on): 16 four-byte entries
Tutorials (TUTID_) (Tutorial::Initialize(const void*,int) gets header +0x54/+0x58; Tutorial::Get(int) = table+i*0x14)
Achievement reward lists header (AchieveBonus::Initialize gets header +0x5C): four {list, count} pairs (GetRoute/GetBattle/GetVisit return the first three)
Achievement rewards, list 1 (AchieveBonus::GetRoute)
Achievement rewards, list 2 (AchieveBonus::GetBattle)
Achievement rewards, list 3 (AchieveBonus::GetVisit)
Achievement rewards, list 4 (no named getter; AchieveBonus::Initialize stores its address)
Arena opponent lists header (Arena::Initialize gets header +0x60): {low list, count}, {high list, count}
Arena opponents, low list (Arena::GetLow; ArenaData::CalculateEnemy uses it below a threshold of 21)
Arena opponents, high list (Arena::GetHigh)
